definitions.explanation: A machine or appliance that automatically makes ice cubes. Refers both to built-in refrigerator units and standalone commercial machines used in hotels and restaurants.

examples.japanese: {製氷機|せいひょうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{製氷機|せいひょうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an ice machine in the hotel hallway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{製氷機|せいひょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to put water in the refrigerator's automatic ice maker.

notes:
Compound of {製氷|せいひょう} (ice-making) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). Found in modern refrigerators and as standalone commercial appliances in hotels, restaurants, and offices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{製氷機|せいひょうき}: automatic ice maker
- {製氷機|せいひょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put water in the ice maker
- {製氷機|せいひょうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}する→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧: the ice maker breaks down

- ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧: ice (general)
